ble_219_0c04ef9c.name: le_device_db_tlv_get_entry
ble_219_0c04ef9c.summary: Read one 60-byte LE device DB record from TLV storage and unpack its fields
ble_219_0c04ef9c.description: Calls the TLV backend get-tag callback (*DAT_2000fd0c)(ctx=DAT_2000fd08, tag='BTD'<<8 | index, buf, 0x3c). If exactly 0x3c bytes were returned, copies the requested fields out of the stack buffer, each only when its output pointer is non-NULL: 16-byte key block at +30 (LTK), u16 at +46 (EDIV), 8-byte at +48 (random number), and four single bytes at +56..+59 (key size, authenticated, authorized, secure-connection flags). On a size mismatch outputs are left untouched. This matches BTstack le_device_db_tlv.c, which stores one record per bonded device under tag 'BTD\0'+index.

params.name: param_1
params.description: device DB slot index 0..3 (OR-ed into tag 0x42544400)

params.name: param_2
params.description: out u16 EDIV, may be NULL

params.name: param_3
params.description: out 8-byte random number (rand), may be NULL

params.name: param_5
params.description: out u32 key size, may be NULL

params.name: param_6
params.description: out u32 authenticated flag, may be NULL

params.name: param_7
params.description: out u32 authorized flag, may be NULL

params.name: param_8
params.description: out u32 secure-connection flag, may be NULL

ble_219_0c04ef9c.notes: Field-to-name mapping inferred from BTstack le_device_db_entry_t layout; the first 30 bytes (IRK/address) are not exported by this function.

ble_219_0c04f034.name: le_device_db_tlv_configure
ble_219_0c04f034.summary: Install TLV backend and probe which of the 4 device DB slots are populated
ble_219_0c04f034.description: Stores the TLV implementation pointer (DAT_2000fd0c) and its context (DAT_2000fd08), clears the in-use count (DAT_2000fd10) and the four per-slot flags starting at 0x2000fd04. Then for slots 0..3 calls the backend get callback with tag 0x42544400|slot and a 0x3c-byte buffer; every slot returning exactly 0x3c bytes gets its flag set to 1 and increments the count. Corresponds to BTstack le_device_db_tlv_configure.

params.name: param_1
params.description: btstack_tlv_t implementation (first word is the get_tag function pointer)

params.name: param_2
params.description: TLV context passed back to the callbacks

ble_219_0c04f0a4.name: ble_ctrl_clear_pairing_flags
ble_219_0c04f0a4.summary: Zero a group of seven single-byte flag/state variables
ble_219_0c04f0a4.description: Writes 0 to bytes at 0x2000ffe9, 0x2000ff55, 0x2000ff6b, 0x2000ff5b, 0x2000ff5f, 0x2000ff63 and 0x2000ff67. These sit next to the key-distribution bytes set by the sibling setters (0x2000ff56/58) and are probably per-pairing state. Called once from the same init routine (ble_219_0c051eb8) that loads the keys and address structures.
ble_219_0c04f0a4.notes: Exact meaning of each cleared byte unknown.

ble_219_0c04f0c8.name: ble_ctrl_store_keys_and_addrs
ble_219_0c04f0c8.summary: Copy three 16-byte keys and three short address/info blobs into controller globals
ble_219_0c04f0c8.description: Copies param_1, param_2 and param_3 (16 bytes each) to 0x2000fe00, 0x2000fe10 and 0x2000fe20. Then copies a 3-byte item (u16 + u8) from param_4 to 0x2000fe30, and two 7-byte items (u32 + u16 + u8, written with unaligned stores) from param_5 and param_6 to 0x2000fe33 and 0x2000fe3a. The 7-byte items look like address-type + 6-byte BD_ADDR records and the 16-byte items like IRK/LTK/CSRK style keys, but this is inferred from sizes only.
ble_219_0c04f0c8.notes: Semantic naming speculative; layout of copies is certain.

ble_219_0c04f848.name: ble_ctrl_set_key_dist_flags
ble_219_0c04f848.summary: Translate two key-distribution bitmasks into controller-internal flag bytes
ble_219_0c04f848.description: Clears 0x2000ff58, 0x2000ff59 and 0x2000ff57. For param_2 (bit0 -> 0x03, bit1 -> OR 0x0c, bit2 -> OR 0x10) builds 0x2000ff58; for param_1 with the same mapping builds 0x2000ff56. The bit0/1/2 layout matches the SMP key distribution field (EncKey, IdKey, Sign), expanded into 2-bit groups plus a 1-bit group. param_1 is likely the initiator and param_2 the responder distribution.

params.name: param_1
params.description: key distribution bitmask (bit0 enc, bit1 id, bit2 sign) -> stored at 0x2000ff56

ble_219_0c0531d0.name: ble_slot_test_flag
ble_219_0c0531d0.summary: Test whether a bit is set in the flag word of the slot with a given id
ble_219_0c0531d0.description: The module keeps a 4-entry table of 16-byte slots at 0x20010198..0x200101d8; byte +12 of each slot is an id (0xff means unused) and the u32 at +8 is a flag/bitmask word. Returns false immediately for id 0xff, then scans the table for a slot whose id equals param_1 (a redundant second scan repeats the search to find its index) and returns whether bit (param_2 & 0xff) of that slot's flag word is set. Returns false if no slot matches.

returns.description: true if the bit is set

ble_219_0c0531d0.notes: Slot table is probably per-connection or per-activity state; not confirmed.

ble_219_0c053390.name: ble_slot_set_flag
ble_219_0c053390.summary: Set or clear a bit in the flag word of the slot with a given id
ble_219_0c053390.description: Same 4-entry, 16-byte-stride table at 0x20010198 as ble_slot_test_flag. Returns without action if param_1 is 0xff or no slot has that id at +12. Otherwise, if param_3 is non-zero ORs 1 << (param_2 & 0xff) into the slot's flag word (+8), else clears that bit. Not interrupt-protected.

params.name: param_3
params.description: non-zero to set, zero to clear

ble_219_0c05341c.name: ble_slot_count_used
ble_219_0c05341c.summary: Count slots in the 4-entry table whose id byte is not 0xff
ble_219_0c05341c.description: Walks the four 16-byte slots at 0x20010198 and counts those whose byte at +12 differs from 0xff (the free marker). Returns the count 0..4. Used by several callers deciding whether any slot/connection is active.

ble_219_0c053764.name: ble_slot_get_header_ptr

ble_219_0c053764.description: Returns constant &DAT_20010188, the 16 bytes immediately before the slot table at 0x20010198. No other work.

ble_219_0c053ef4.name: ble_pair_table_lookup
ble_219_0c053ef4.summary: Look up a 16-bit key in an array of {key,value} u16 pairs and compare the value
ble_219_0c053ef4.description: Iterates up to param_4 entries (count effectively limited to 8-bit arithmetic) of 4-byte records {u16 key, u16 value} starting at param_3. On the first entry whose key equals param_1, returns 0 if its value equals param_2 and 3 otherwise. If no key matches (or count is 0) returns 0xffff. Looks like a handle/value validation helper where 0=OK, 3=mismatch, 0xffff=not found.

returns.description: 0 match, 3 value mismatch, 0xffff key not found

ble_219_0c053ef4.notes: Return code semantics (3 = error status) inferred.

ble_219_0c0555dc.name: ble_pack_version_nibbles
ble_219_0c0555dc.summary: OR the three nibble bytes into the 24-bit packed word at 0x20012cb0
ble_219_0c0555dc.description: Computes DAT_20012cb0 |= DAT_20012caf | (DAT_20012cad << 16) | (DAT_20012cae << 8), combining the nibble values stored by ble_unpack_version_nibbles into a packed value. The old contents are ORed in, not cleared. No direct callers (indirect entry), and the nibble at 0x20012cac is not used.
ble_219_0c0555dc.notes: Likely a Bluetooth version/revision or class-of-device style value; unconfirmed.

ble_219_0c055604.name: ble_get_packed_word_12cb0

ble_219_0c055610.name: ble_unpack_version_nibbles
ble_219_0c055610.summary: Split a 16-bit value into four nibble bytes at 0x20012cac..caf
ble_219_0c055610.description: Stores bits 15..12 of param_1 to DAT_20012cac, bits 11..8 to DAT_20012cad, bits 7..4 to DAT_20012cae and bits 3..0 to DAT_20012caf (each as a separate byte). Called from ble_219_0c0297b0 during configuration.

params.name: param_1
params.description: 16-bit value, e.g. a packed BCD-like version number
